notes: [exploretoward-02, 10-02 (OWNER: 'run explore-toward after the ore tunnel'): variant for fleet 3edf1d6, branch explore-on-3edf1d6 @ ccead1e = 3edf1d6 + the reviewed explore-toward change (96bc68d/bfc5a21/4458107); one import conflict resolved; npm test green. Launched by chain-after.sh when oretunnel-03 ends, choosing the variant by fleet sha. WHY NOW: 53/80 bots hold no pickaxe, 52 of them no wood; 68% of 1,186 log gathers fail unreachable/refused; explore walked to iron whatever the task.] EXPLORE WALKED TO IRON WHATEVER THE TASK (2026-09-29). explore takes the first sighting in an iron-first order when no `toward` is given, and the model cannot give one (explore declares only `blocks`; 16,055 of 16,056 proposals). Codex measured 28-29 Sep on 80b3bbd: 1,287 of 8,766 executed explores ran under a wood/dirt/sand/stone task and walked to IRON (9.8 execution h); control 78/78 iron-task explores chose iron. THE FIX (both engines designed; both reviewed the implementation, Claude AGREE+2 changes, Codex CHANGE, all applied): exploreintent.mjs maps a gather rung, the wood stockpile, the iron rung (by id) or a detour naming logs/sand/raw_iron/coal to the kinds the reflex sights; stone and dirt tasks are OUT (stone is buried, not distant; dirt is never sighted). Supplied AFTER admission on a copy of the args, so every gate key is unchanged. A family means the nearest member; no sighting means no target (never iron); the walk re-aims after each leg and stops on arrival (arrival is success); a null heading is no longer due east. Rows `_explore_toward_milestone` (target + the old pick as legacy=) and `_explore_toward_milestone_end` (arrived / not). 18 tests incl. explore() driven with a drifting pathfinder; 14 mutants all killed; 204/204.

licence.note: Written only by this build, only for a task-aimed explore. The baseline has no exploreintent module and no such row kind.

require.name: explore targeting activity (the population this changes)

draw_exposure.note: Dry run 09-29: 1,282 control rows in 3 h (~85 per pool). In-scope explores are ~0.74-0.80/bot-h (both reviews).

exposure.note: Ready = >= 15 canary aimed rows AND control _explore_toward_known >= 1. ~0.8/bot-h in scope -> ~15 rows in 2 h on 10 bots, ~4 h on 5.

own_lines.note: CORRECTNESS: an aimed walk targeted a kind its task did not ask for. Judged only on >= 15 canary rows (unchanged code writes none, and a zero there would be vacuous -- dry run 09-29 printed NOT judged).
POSITIVE CONTROL: explore targeting is visible to this query (1,282 in the dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: arrived share of aimed walks, none_known share, target != legacy share, explore distance_moved and failed/no_effect DiD. Between-pool noise is large: the dry run on UNCHANGED hive-b read median distance 56 -> 3 and failed share DiD +0.29 in 3 h. An items effect is not measurable at ~0.8 aimed walks/bot-h.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid. Sand targets are shorelines: name any drowning in the read.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions.
